brief_rationale: The trajectory met the responsibility-chain duties: the doctor used the workspace/record path, treated delayed mobile snippets as time-dependent rather than definitive current deterioration, repeatedly screened evolving newborn red flags, repaired the discharge-medication confusion, and drove the family to concrete neonatal/pediatric follow-up with receipt. Closure was traceable because the family repeated back medicines, follow-up dates, escalation criteria, and shared the plan with another caregiver. Multiple high-order points were actively completed, including dynamic reprioritization around feeding/respiratory status, medication-chain repair, verification of delayed-record misinterpretation, and bounded follow-up for prior HIE/asphyxia risk. No serious or minor responsibility-chain error or important non-chain defect is evident, supporting a Perfect grade.
